rows.quote: For the pQTL analysis, we obtained summary statistics for 4907 plasma proteins from a large‐scale study by Ferkingstad et al., 19 accessed via the deCODE database (https://www.decode.com). pQTLs are categorized based on their genomic proximity to protein‐coding genes: cis‐pQTLs represent nearby regulatory elements, while trans‐pQTLs indicate distant regulatory influences. 13 Contemporary research typically defines these categories using distance thresholds of 500 kb or 1000 kb.
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad E, Sulem P, Atlason BA, Sveinbjornsson G, Magnusson MI, Styrmisdottir EL, et al. Large‐scale integration of the plasma proteome with genetics and disease. Nat Genet. 2021;53:1712–1721.
rows.coder_note: Sentence attributes the pQTL summary statistics for 4907 proteins to the study by Ferkingstad et al., reference 19, whose DOI is the source identifier of one dictionary row only.
